input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the air volume served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v6, from the occupant-CO2 rise and scrubber-driven decay.
hypotheses: The lab is a single well-mixed zone during the test.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v6 remains in one position throughout; residual exchange with Hab-B is not measured and is small enough not to dominate the fitted Lab decay.
The three Lab occupants remain in the Lab at steady activity, with no entry or exit, so their aggregate CO2 source is approximately steady.
The scrubber's documented effective flow at accepted speed commands applies in situ; fit the decay toward its nonzero equilibrium and calculate V_lab = Qe × tau.
Hab-B CO2 is recorded each minute as an exchange diagnostic; correlated Lab/Hab-B changes would reject the negligible-exchange hypothesis.

monitoring.reason: The test deliberately raises Lab CO2; stop for out-of-band vitals, monitoring loss, or occupancy change.

steps.why: Hold the Lab as one zone and reduce effective removal so occupant CO2 rises several hundred ppm above the 1800 ppm starting reading; record Lab and Hab-B CO2, accepted command, occupancy, and vitals every minute.
Keep all other conditions fixed, restore full scrubber speed, and record the decay every minute for a nonzero-equilibrium exponential fit.

abort.when: Lab CO2 reaches or exceeds limits.co2AbortPpm.
The scrubber refuses either commanded speed.
Battery state of charge is below the threshold percent.
Any monitored subject is outside 45–120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or any additional person enters the Lab.

expected.rise: At 30% speed, Lab CO2 should rise from the measured 1800 ppm start by several hundred ppm while remaining below 2800 ppm; failure to rise distinctly above sensor noise rejects an informative rise phase.
expected.decay: At 100% speed, Lab CO2 should fall smoothly toward a nonzero equilibrium and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau); V_lab is Qe×tau in m3.
expected.opening_check: With hatch-1-v6 closed, Hab-B CO2 should not show a strongly correlated response; correlation or a poor single-exponential Lab fit indicates material inter-zone exchange and invalidates the one-zone estimate.
expected.source_check: The three named occupants must remain present at steady activity; any entry, exit, or activity change invalidates the source condition.
expected.command_check: Both speed commands must be accepted and reported; refusal aborts the test.
expected.safety_check: CO2 must remain below 2800 ppm during planned operation and the test aborts at 3000 ppm or on battery/vitals criteria.

justifications.reason: Planned ceiling remains below signed abort ceiling.

Full-speed decay stays above signed floor.
